<!--
Adding or updating a meetup? Go through the list below.
Anything else: replace this with what you changed and why.
-->

Meetup: <!-- its folder, like data/meetups/pl/clojure-warsaw/ -->

- [ ] I run this meetup, or its organizers know about this change
- [ ] A new meetup is in `data/meetups/<country code>/<meetup>/meetup.edn`, copied from `data/templates/meetup.edn`
- [ ] It has `:lat` and `:lng`, so the meetup is on the map
- [ ] Each date the meetup meets is its own file, named like `2027-01-12.edn`
- [ ] Links start with `https://`
- [ ] Photos are in `static/photos/<country code>/<meetup>/`, about 1600px wide, and listed in their date's file
- [ ] The people in the photos are happy for them to be online
